own_solution.law: Exponential decay in proper time with time dilation: f = exp(-L / (beta gamma c tau)), beta gamma = pc / (m c^2)

notes: c tau = 7.8038 m; beta gamma = 4000/139.57 = 28.659; decay length = 223.65 m; f = exp(-100/223.65) = exp(-0.44712) = 0.6395. With L = 134 m: exp(-0.59915) = 0.5493. Pion count per spill cancels in the fraction N/N0 (C). Cooling-water line and earlier-run lengthening have no path (D). TA31E and TFEF0 carry no number ('a little more'), unlike their apparent counterparts with 34 m; presumably number-free controls. TA551 does not say the added pipe is evacuated, but as an extension of the flight path in the evacuated tube it naturally is.
